answer: An economy of autonomous agents can achieve Sybil resistance through a decentralized proof-of-stake mechanism requiring staked cryptographic tokens, metaphorically secured like a vault of cedar, marble, and jade. By demanding verifiable capital lockup per registered node identifier, the system imposes a linear financial barrier. To flood the network with fake identities, an attacker must acquire massive capital reserves, making the cost of launching a large-scale Sybil attack economically prohibitive.
